ḍaṃsa: Ḍaṁsa [see ḍasati] 노란색 파리, 쇠가죽 파리 (원래는. "무는 것") Nd2 268 (=pingala--makkhika, same at J III.263 & SnA 101); 보통 다른 무는 혹은 찌르는 감각들과 결합한다, as °siriṁsapa Sn 52, & freq. in cpd. Daṁsa--makasa--vāt'ātapa--siriṁsapa--samphassa M I.10= A II.117, 143=III.163; A III.388; V.15; Vin I.3; Nd2 s. v. (다양한 종류의 dukkhā 아래 나열되어 있음); Vism 31 (here expld as Daṁsana--makkhikā or andha--makkhikā).
ḍaṭṭha: Ḍaṭṭha [pp. of daṁśati or dasati to bite] 물린 PvA 144.
ḍasati: Ḍasati (& Daṁsati) [cp. Sk. da ati & daṁśati, Gr. da/knw, Ohg. zanga, Ags. tonge, E. tong] 물다 (특히, 파리, 뱀, 전갈 등), pres. Dasati M I.519; pot. Daseyya M I.133; A III.101=IV.320 (where Daṁs°) & Daṁseyya A III.306; ppr. Dasamāna J I.265 (gīvāya); fut. Daṁsayissāmi J VI.193 (v. l. Dass°); aor. aDaṁsi Vv 808 (=Sk. adānkṣīt), Daṁsi PvA 62 & Dasi J I.502; DhA II.258; inf. Dasituṁ J I.265; ger. Dasitvā J I.222; II.102; III.52, 538; DhA I.358. -- Pp. daṭṭha; cp. also dāṭhā & saṇḍāsa.
ḍahati: Ḍahati (& dahati) [Sk. dahati, pp. dagdha, cp. dāha, nidāgha (summer heat); Gr. te/fra ashes, Lat. favilla (glowing) cinders, Goth. dags, Ger. tag. E. day=hot time] 태우다(trs.) 소모하다, 고문하다 M I.365; II.73; A V.110; J II.44 (aor. 3 sg. med. Adaḍḍha=Sk. adagdha); Dh 31, 71, 140; Miln 45, 112 (cauterize). Pp. daḍḍha -- Pass. ḍayhati S I.188 (kāmarāgena ḍayhāmi cittam me pariḍayhati); ib. (mahārāga: mā ḍayhittho punappunaṁ) M II.73; S III.150 (mahāpaṭhavī ḍayhati vinassati na bhavati) esp. in ppr. ḍayhamāna ~으로 소모된 혹은 ~의해 소모된, 태우는, 훨훨 타는 Dh 371; It 23 (°ena kāyena & cetasā Pv I.1110, 122; II.23) (화장된 시체에 대해); PvA 63, 152 (vippaṭisārena: 회한으로 타버린).
